summary: Adds a 16-bit immediate to ra.
effects: Writes ra; does not modify memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Overflow wraps modulo 2^16; reserved bits must be zero.

summary: Subtracts a 16-bit immediate from ra.
effects: Writes ra; does not modify memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Underflow wraps modulo 2^16; reserved bits must be zero.

summary: Loads a data-memory word using a base register and signed word offset.
effects: Writes ra; reads memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Offset is signed 6-bit word offset -32..31; effective address wraps modulo 2^16 before implementation address truncation.

summary: Stores a data-memory word using a base register and signed word offset.
effects: Does not write registers; writes memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Offset is signed 6-bit word offset -32..31; effective address wraps modulo 2^16 before implementation address truncation.

summary: Stores a return address in r58 and branches to an absolute target.
effects: Writes r58; does not modify memory; branches; flags: none.
edge_cases: Target is an 8-bit instruction index; nested calls must save r58 when needed.

summary: Returns to the instruction index stored in r58.
effects: Does not write registers; does not modify memory; branches; flags: none.
edge_cases: Return address register is fixed to r58 by the Base-16 toolchain ABI.

summary: Branches to the instruction index stored in rb.
effects: Does not write registers; does not modify memory; branches; flags: none.
edge_cases: Only the low 8 bits of rb are used as the target.

operation: if signed(ra) < signed(rb) then pc = target8
summary: Signed less-than branch.
effects: Does not write registers; does not modify memory; may branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Target is an 8-bit instruction index; reserved bits must be zero.

operation: if signed(ra) >= signed(rb) then pc = target8
summary: Signed greater-than-or-equal branch.
effects: Does not write registers; does not modify memory; may branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Target is an 8-bit instruction index; reserved bits must be zero.

operation: if unsigned(ra) < unsigned(rb) then pc = target8
summary: Unsigned less-than branch.
effects: Does not write registers; does not modify memory; may branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Target is an 8-bit instruction index; reserved bits must be zero.

operation: if unsigned(ra) >= unsigned(rb) then pc = target8
summary: Unsigned greater-than-or-equal branch.
effects: Does not write registers; does not modify memory; may branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Target is an 8-bit instruction index; reserved bits must be zero.

summary: Adds two registers and writes the result to ra.
effects: Writes ra; does not modify memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Overflow wraps modulo 2^16; reserved bits must be zero.

summary: Subtracts rb from ra and writes the result to ra.
effects: Writes ra; does not modify memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Underflow wraps modulo 2^16; reserved bits must be zero.

summary: Computes the bitwise AND of ra and rb.
effects: Writes ra; does not modify memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Reserved bits must be zero.

summary: Computes the bitwise OR of ra and rb.
effects: Writes ra; does not modify memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Mnemonic is OOR to avoid ambiguity with assembler keywords; reserved bits must be zero.

summary: Computes the bitwise XOR of ra and rb.
effects: Writes ra; does not modify memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Reserved bits must be zero.

summary: Shifts ra right by an immediate amount.
effects: Writes ra; does not modify memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Shift amount is reduced modulo 16; reserved bits must be zero.

summary: Shifts ra left by an immediate amount.
effects: Writes ra; does not modify memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Shift amount is reduced modulo 16; reserved bits must be zero.

summary: Rotates ra right by an immediate amount.
effects: Writes ra; does not modify memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Rotate amount is reduced modulo 16; rotate by zero leaves ra unchanged; reserved bits must be zero.

summary: Rotates ra left by an immediate amount.
effects: Writes ra; does not modify memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Rotate amount is reduced modulo 16; rotate by zero leaves ra unchanged; reserved bits must be zero.

summary: Inverts every bit in ra.
effects: Writes ra; does not modify memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Reserved bits must be zero.

summary: Multiplies ra by rb and keeps the low 16 bits.
effects: Writes ra; does not modify memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Product truncates to 16 bits; reserved bits must be zero.

operation: if ra == rb then pc = target8
summary: Branches to an absolute target when two registers are equal.
effects: Does not write registers; does not modify memory; may branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Target is an 8-bit instruction index; reserved bits must be zero.
example: MVI r1, 5|MVI r2, 5|JEQ r1, r2, equal

operation: if ra != rb then pc = target8
summary: Branches to an absolute target when two registers differ.
effects: Does not write registers; does not modify memory; may branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Target is an 8-bit instruction index; reserved bits must be zero.
example: MVI r1, 5|MVI r2, 6|JNE r1, r2, different

summary: Branches unconditionally to an absolute target.
effects: Does not write registers; does not modify memory; branches; flags: none.
edge_cases: Target is an 8-bit instruction index; reserved bits must be zero.

summary: Performs no operation.
effects: Does not write registers; does not modify memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Only pc advances; reserved bits must be zero.

summary: Copies rb into ra.
effects: Writes ra; does not modify memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Reserved bits must be zero.

summary: Loads a 16-bit immediate into ra.
effects: Writes ra; does not modify memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: All 16 immediate bits are preserved.

summary: Loads a data-memory word into ra.
effects: Writes ra; reads memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Address is a 12-bit word index; reserved bits must be zero.

summary: Stores ra into data memory.
effects: Does not write registers; writes memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Address is a 12-bit word index; reserved bits must be zero.

summary: Stores a 16-bit immediate into data memory.
effects: Does not write registers; writes memory; does not branch; flags: none.
edge_cases: Address is a 12-bit word index; reserved bits must be zero.
